## Review and merge

Docs-only PRs require passing CI. Other PRs require a completed Pullfrog review
of the current head and resolution of actionable threads. Record the review URL
and head SHA. After a pushed fix, require a review of the new head.

Use the global PR lifecycle and `~/.agents/bin/pr-ship <n> --repo flowcool/Smart_Plant`.
The known sticky `pullfrog-approval` status alone is not a blocker; all other
required CI checks must pass. Publication and deployment require their existing
authorization.
